items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In fact, Leo Durocher was over there one time. We got to meet all the ballplayers.

ctx.x: Was that all week, or just Monday?

Every night. Right across the street was Roy Campanella’s liquor store. Any time some famous ballplayer would come over there, they’d run across the street and tell us, and we’d go over there and meet them. Don Newcombe, Hank Thompson... In fact, Leo Durocher was over there one time. We got to meet all the ballplayers.
I guess the New York Giants were Harlem’s team.
